title: Plans Atlas — navigable drawing-set index
description: Makes the PDF drawing set navigable like a linked web document without altering the drawings. One record per sheet plus a concept index (trade / spec section / phase / area) and a callout-link graph, all classified by CSI MasterFormat division (the sole classification system and universal sort key). Built deterministically by build_atlas_data.py (never hand-rolled per run) and rendered by build_atlas_html.py into a self-contained offline viewer in NTXP's brand system. Live markups and generated phase-of-scope images are STAGED here as render requests — the atlas records them; ntxp-pdf-markups-and-redlines and construction-scope-visualizer produce them; nothing is invented by this layer.

source_set.description: The drawing pack this atlas indexes. The atlas never modifies these files.

pack_qa.description: Result of the pre-atlas pack inventory (duplicates, text layer, sheet size). A blocked pack gates atlas building.

sheets.description: One entry per drawing sheet, in CSI-division order then sheet-number order.

sheet_id.description: Stable id other records point at (e.g. 'A-101').

discipline.description: Sheet-set discipline (G, C, A, S, M, E, P, FP…) used for viewer tabs.

csi.description: Primary division(s) the sheet serves; the universal sort key.

divisions.description: All two-digit divisions with scope on this sheet.

image.description: Rendered page image path or data URI for the viewer canvas.

ocr.description: Provider name when the sheet text came from OCR (rapidocr, mistral-titleblock); false when read from the PDF text layer.

searchable.description: False when the sheet has no text layer — the viewer marks it 'not searchable' instead of pretending.

areas.description: Rooms / areas / wings shown (verbatim from the documents).

links.description: The callout hyperlink graph: plan → section/detail/schedule/spec, each with a normalized source box so the viewer can draw the hotspot and offer Back navigation. Extracted deterministically from callout tags (e.g. '5/A-501'); judgement never invents a target.

from_box.description: Normalized [x0,y0,x1,y1] (0..1) hotspot on the source sheet.

to_spec_section.description: MasterFormat section number when the link lands in the spec book (per-section PDF from specs-skill).

to_href.description: Resolved hyperlink (spec PDF, workbook sheet, dashboard anchor, OCR4 screenshot URL).

concepts.description: The fast-navigation index: pick a concept, land on every place it appears. Each anchor points at a sheet (and optionally a box), a spec section, or a canonical-model record — never at re-stated data.

trades.description: One entry per division with scope, in MasterFormat order.

takeoff_ids.description: QTO rows for this trade — quantities live once, in the Summary QTO.

trade_href.description: Link to the trade's budget page / trades row.

pdf.description: Per-section PDF (specs-skill 'Specs By CSI' output) when available.

renders.description: Live-generation ledger: rendered markups (ntxp-pdf-markups-and-redlines) and generated phase-of-scope images (construction-scope-visualizer). A request is STAGED from the viewer, produced by the owning skill, then recorded here with provenance — the atlas never draws or generates imagery itself.

request.description: What was asked for, verbatim ('shade Div 09 scope on A-101', 'render finishes phase, Rm 114').

output.description: Path/URL of the produced file once ready.

search.description: Word-box index the viewer searches. Matching is punctuation-insensitive ('FD2' finds 'FD-2').

words_file.description: Sidecar JSON with per-sheet normalized word boxes (kept out of the main record for size).
